caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be an old, rustic, and roughly-shaped wooden or leather item, shown against a plain, light beige background. The object has a thick, blocky, upright base with an uneven surface and an attached horizontal extension that curves upward, resembling the shape of a foot or hoof. Its colors are predominantly shades of brown and gray, with darker lines and lighter highlights suggesting texture, cracks, and wear on the material. At the top of the upright base, there is a small looped or handle-like extension. The entire composition is centered, with the object occupying most of the vertical space and no additional background elements present. The artist's signature, "Juanita Donatson," appears at the bottom right corner of the drawing in small, neat text.
title: Wooden Stirrup
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
